title: Equity index trend day continuation
thesis: US equity index futures may continue on trend days when early breadth, opening drive, and shallow pullbacks align.
market_intuition: Opening drive strength with shallow pullbacks may identify days where buying dips outperforms fading extremes.
entry_idea: Enter long on first shallow pullback after opening drive confirmation.
exit_idea: Exit on trend failure, trailing stop, or session close.
risk_assumption: Fixed R stop below pullback low with daily loss cap.
cost_slippage_assumption: Use futures commissions plus one tick slippage per side, stress to two ticks.
data_source: Futures OHLCV and optional breadth proxy.
disproof_condition: Reject if edge is limited to a handful of high-volatility trend days or fails in holdout years.

missing_assumptions.label: Breadth proxy definition
missing_assumptions.why_it_matters: The thesis names breadth, so the experiment must define whether breadth is sourced, proxied, or excluded.

clarification_answers.q_benchmark: Compare to opening-drive entry without pullback filter.
